messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Gabapentin can cause weight gain, although it is not common.
In clinical trials, a small number of people (roughly 2 in 100) gained weight while taking it.
Gabapentin can also cause swelling in the legs, feet, or hands.
This swelling is known as peripheral edema.
The swelling may add to weight changes.
The swelling becomes more common with age.
Triplet: ["swelling in legs, feet, or hands", "has alternative name", "peripheral edema"]

The relation 'has alternative name' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or effect is also known by the object name.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'causes': The subject drug leads to or results in the effect or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
C. 'includes': The subject condition or category includes the specific condition or entity specified by the object entity.
D. 'have': The subject group of individuals has or is associated with the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
E. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
